question: Which of the following states in India has no Panchayati Raj institution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Institutions of Panchayati Raj:**

 
• Gram Sabha is the primary body of the Panchayati Raj system. 

 
 
• This permanent body is the body of the electorate.
 
• This means that all other institutions – Gram Panchayat, Zilla Parishad, etc. (which we will be talking about later) – are elected by the Gram Sabha. Moreover, the Gram Sabha acts as a forum where people can discuss matters of governance and development.
 
• Therefore, Gram Sabha is the primary and fundamental component of the local self-government system.
 
 
 
• Gram Panchayat is the lowest level in the panchayat pyramid system.
 
 
• ​The main work of the Gram Panchayat is to take care of social issues, construct and maintain schools, roads and drainage facilities, etc., and to levy and collect local taxes.
 
• ​The Gram Panchayat is accountable to the general body of voters in the village, i.e. the Gram Sabha, as well as to the two levels of authority above it in the hierarchy.
 
 
 
• Nyaya Panchayat is a part of the Panchayat system which is formed to settle disputes among the villagers.
 
 
• Its various functions are: It strives to solve petty criminal and civil cases, wherein the parties in dispute explain their sides to the members of the Panchayat.
 
 

From the above, we can say that Gram Cooperative Society is not a Panchayati Raj Institution.
